array reorder: no new caption or protected segment
fact id change: one actual work event
fact operation change: one actual work event
fact text change: one actual work event
fact source_id change: one actual work event
fact sourceId change: one actual work event
document id change: one actual work event

document sourceId change: one actual work event

stable_work_identity_metadata_only.integration: Movie.build_plan labels and protected windows compared on tiny in-memory metadata; no frame files opened
stable_work_identity_metadata_only.geometry_use: Fact/document rects excluded from work-change detection; unchanged camera geometry paths
stable_work_identity_metadata_only.identity: Order-independent id, operation, explicit source_id/sourceId; facts also compare text

checks.dynamic_source_binding_after_fix: missing/malformed/mismatched explicit SHA rejected with exit 2

caption_layout_metadata_only.basis: Existing font metrics and layout math only; no actual UI pixels read or rendered

v5_contract.capture_source_commit: Required capture.source_commit must exactly match required explicit --source-commit ACTUAL40HEX; no default
v5_contract.capture_geometry: CSS viewport and deviceScale; frame file/t; samples activeStepRect/excerptRect/exactSpanRect/factRect/readheadRect/railRect/transportRect/facts/documents/state/operation; true pointer/click/hold/resume/final events
v5_contract.output: 45–60s silent 1920x1080 h264, encoded 30fps; duplicate preceding actual native frames; never claim native 30fps
v5_contract.camera: Active >=1.4x when full excerpt plus actual destination fits; otherwise report measured bound and preserve union; full UI on inspection, native clicks/travel, decision/final
v5_contract.captions: 42px font in a 64px reserved external gutter; 2–4 word active verbs; no product overlap
v5_contract.final_hold: Actual final frame only, just enough to reach 45s; no invented progress
v5_contract.active_framing_acceptance: Actual 1.4x active framing requires visual inspection after receiving the future published capture; metadata math does not establish visual acceptance
